mentions.name: Virtual Diwali
mentions.description: A browser-based casual game and shared experience celebrating Diwali, where players walk through an old neighbourhood down to a river, light 108 oil lamps (diyas), set off crackers, and release lanterns into a sky shared by everyone. Recent additions include a lamp kept burning per Indian tradition and a rooftop garden that keeps growing, with more missions planned. It runs in the browser with no login or ads; around 1,100 players have lit all 108 diyas and 1,600 lanterns have been released so far.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on a casual game / experience about Indian festivals as a hobby project. This started as a Diwali night. You can walk through an old neighbourhood down to a river, light 108 oil lamps, set of crackers and send lanterns to a sky that is shared by everyone. It runs in browser without login or any ads.
